reviewers.name: agent-audit
reviewers.adds: MCP configuration, prompt-injection patterns, tool privilege and taint rules (66 rules, OWASP Agentic Top 10).
reviewers.run: installed as an adapter; runs automatically when present (pip install agent-audit).
reviewers.reason: pip install agent-audit to enable its AGENT-* rules

reviewers.name: kodus
reviewers.adds: Self-hosted CodeRabbit alternative with bring-your-own model; PR-level review comments.
reviewers.run: requires a deployed service plus a model key; use its SARIF export, merged via AAD_REVIEW_SARIF.
reviewers.reason: requires a deployed service plus a model key; use its SARIF export, merged via AAD_REVIEW_SARIF.

reviewers.name: brooks-lint
reviewers.adds: Opinionated architecture, maintainability and remediation review alongside a coding agent.
reviewers.run: model-key driven; the deterministic DEBT-* rules above cover the same angle offline.
reviewers.reason: model-key driven; the deterministic DEBT-* rules above cover the same angle offline.

reviewers.name: zeroshot
reviewers.adds: Reviewer loops: agents critique and repair each other behind workflow gates.
reviewers.run: harness, not a scanner; no artefact contract to consume, so it is not wired into scoring.
reviewers.reason: harness, not a scanner; no artefact contract to consume, so it is not wired into scoring.

reviewers.name: git-lrc
reviewers.adds: Micro-reviews at commit time instead of PR time, so a defect is caught before it lands.
reviewers.run: git hook plus model key; commit-time by design, so a static audit cannot invoke it.
reviewers.reason: git hook plus model key; commit-time by design, so a static audit cannot invoke it.

reviewers.name: coderabbit
reviewers.adds: 20+ linters plus AI review on pull requests.
reviewers.run: proprietary and hosted; free for public repos, private repos only get summaries. Not usable offline.
reviewers.reason: hosted service; cannot run against a local upload

reviewers.note: External reviewers are never executed by this audit; only their SARIF is merged.

report.score_explanation: JevDecisionModel port: start at 100 and subtract 20 per critical, 10 per high, 5 per medium and 2 per low finding, clamped at 0 and graded A-F. Library-origin and baselined findings are shown but not scored. The score is a triage heuristic, not a security certification.
